# feat(admin): the plugin's sub-navigation shell: groups, the Micelio mark, permissions hide items

<!-- bogd3v/micelio-plugin-core#43 as read with gh issue view on 2026-10-24: the input of micelio-plugin-core-43.md -->

Part of #62.

## Why

The status page (#32) is one page under one menu entry. The builder adds a dozen pages (preview, builder, catalogue, templates, review, themes, customize, export, about, fediverse) and Strapi 5 gives a plugin one `addMenuLink` entry, so the plugin needs its own sub-navigation, as the design shows (https://claude.ai/artifact/HANdCR4vzcoCQNmcFA9w64, every artboard of the page "Plugin and builder").

## What to build

- `admin/src/components/MicelioSubNav.tsx` on the design system's `SubNav`: groups Overview (Status, Sites), Content (Block catalogue, Page templates, In review with a count badge), Site (Themes, Customize, Fediverse when registered, Export and import), then About, separated.
- Routes under `/plugins/micelio/*`; an item is shown only when the admin has its permission; the entry itself stays.
- The menu icon is the small Micelio mark (`admin/src/components/MicelioIcon.tsx`, 24 viewBox, `currentColor`, stroke 1.75), replacing `StatusIcon`.
- Items that a sibling plugin registers come from the extension point of #41 (`registerAdminPage`); this issue renders them, #41 defines the registration.
- `en.json` and `es.json` for every label; `npm run test:admin` covers the shell with axe and keyboard.

## Requirements

- Additive; `feat` → MINOR.
- Visible focus on every item, `aria-current="page"` on the active one; the sub-nav collapses with Strapi's condensed rail.
- No page content moves in this issue: Status keeps its URL.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The browser suite opens `/admin/plugins/micelio` and sees the groups; a role without `plugin::micelio.status.read` does not see Status but still sees the entry and About.
- [ ] A test plugin that registers an item (from #41) appears in the Site group.
- [ ] axe: 0 violations; every item reachable with Tab, activated with Enter.
- [ ] Verified by the maintainer on the plugin's Docker Compose (`compose.dev.yml`: clean Strapi with the plugin, PostgreSQL and the frontend image), following the steps the PR lists under Tests.

## Depends on

#41 for registered items (can land in parallel; the shell renders the core items without it).

## Progress

Not started.

## Delivery

The agent never pushes on its own. When the maintainer says the manual test on Docker is done, the agent gives the `git add` and `git commit -s` commands with the message (conventional prefix, English, `Co-Authored-By:` trailer); once the maintainer confirms the commit, the agent pushes the branch and opens the PR (REST), with the Docker steps under Tests and `Refs`/`Closes` to this issue. The maintainer reviews the whole diff before merging (standard, sections 11 and 13).
